notes.title: Announcement of "Year-end party! Tien Gow Festival 2024" (12/30)
notes.content:
Hello to all who enjoy Tien Gow.

Today we would like to inform you about a small event.

First of all, thanks to you, "Japanese Style Tien Gow" is now the only game on Steam that allows multiplayer battles (as far as we can confirm).

However, to be honest, since it is still unknown, we do not think that there are many opportunities to battle using the multiplayer feature.

We have opened the "Japanese Style Tien Gow - Official" server on Discord to provide a place for buyers to improve their battle opportunities and interact with each other, and to promote this, we have decided to hold a battle opportunity event at the end of the year, [b]"Year End! Tien Gow Festival 2024" [/b].

The purpose of this event is for the development team to act as an intermediary and guide players on Discord to battle against members participating on the official server, or for the developers themselves to actively battle and interact with each other.

The event is scheduled to take place on December 30, 2024 from 15:00 to 24:00 JST.

There are probably many people who have said, "I want to try multiplayer, but I don't know when the players will be available," "I've gotten so good that I can't compete with NPCs anymore," or "I played a little when multiplayer was introduced, but now I play other games.
By hosting this event, we hope to provide an opportunity to play against other people, show people the fun of PvP that you can't get in single-player, and introduce more people to the game.

In addition, some members of the development team will be streaming multiplayer live on Twitch in the evening (simultaneously with Youtube Live, if adjustments are made).

Guidance and progress will basically be done on a server on Discord.
Please visit the Discord server in advance by clicking the "Discord" button on the title screen of "Japanese Style Tien Gow" (please also agree to the rules).
*If you are already a member, the above procedure is not necessary.

The game will also be available at a discounted price during the Winter Sale 2024.

Why not take this opportunity to invite your friends and family to play a new game on December 30th?

And to promote the game, we would be very grateful if those who already own the game would join us and help make it a success.

The event will be held in Japanese, but overseas participants are also welcome. We will do our best to respond carefully using machine translation, so please come and join us.

If this trial is successful, we are considering making this a regular event.

We look forward to seeing many of you.

notes.title: Announcement of the 2.0 update for Japanese style Tien Gow.
notes.content:
Hello Tien Gow players.
Ahead of the Steam Autumn Sale, we are pleased to announce that we have released an update to Japanese style Tien Gow, including the official release of the multiplayer mode.
Please see the release notes below for more details.

[h1]Update 2.0 Release Notes[/h1].
version 2.0.2, netversion.2.0.0

[h2]Changes to in-game data[/h2]

[h3]Multiplayer experience reset[/h3]
With the official implementation of Multiplayer, the Multiplayer experience that was played as a test will be reset and you will start again from Lv. 1 with the official implementation.

[h2]Specification additions and changes[/h2]

[h3]Official implementation of multiplayer[/h3]
Finally, multiplayer has been officially implemented from beta. With the official implementation, the following features will be implemented

[list]
[*]Addition of titles
A number of titles have been added to the game, which can be obtained in a variety of ways.
They are divided into Title1 and Title2, which can be combined into a single title that can be displayed to other players in multiplayer.
Titles can be obtained by unlocking achievements, setting certain records, leveling up, or through the title raffle described below.

[*]Official implementation of the title change function
This feature allows users to freely change titles obtained through various methods, including the functions described below.
Titles are mainly displayed to other players in multiplayer games, and can be displayed by combining two titles.
You can create your own unique titles, from cool titles to funny titles, so experiment and create your favourite titles.

[*]Implementation of the title gacha
A number of titles have been added that can be obtained through a gacha (title lottery). The gacha ticket is based on the experience gained in single-player and multi-player play, and when used on the title lottery screen, titles that can only be obtained through the lottery will be drawn.
Please note that experience is not reduced by drawing gachas.

[*]Achievements will now be unlocked when conditions are met, even in multiplayer.
Achievements are now unlocked on the results screen in multiplayer.

[*]Added a confirmation message when selecting a tile to reveal and pressing the reveal button.

[*]Added the ability to switch between NPCs after adding an NPC in a multiplayer game room.

[*]Changed so that the optional Auto play setting (formerly known as the 'Auto Play with One Tile') is also enabled in multiplayer.

[*]A link to the Discord server has been added to the title screen
A new 'Japanese Style Tien Gow - Official' server has been set up as a place to find multiplayer opponents and share topics.
We believe that multiplayer is a lot of fun and it's easier to find a partner when there are lots of people around, so please don't hesitate to join us.
Please note that you must agree to the rules on the Discord server.
[/list]

[h3]Corrections/changes concerning NPCs[/h3]

[list]
[*]Improved NPCs.
All NPCs except the first three have had their minds enhanced.
*Overall, we have buffed them in response to feedback that none of the NPCs were strong enough to get used to the game.

[*]Reduced NPC unlock levels.
*The unlock levels have been changed to appear earlier overall.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes and changes to in-game behavior[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed the specification to allow you to pre-select your own pieces in moves other than your own.
[*]Added a feature to deselect all pieces by right-clicking on them while they are selected.
[/list]
*These work for both single player and multiplayer.

[h3]Other additional/changed features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed the description of the 'Auto Play with One Tile' option to 'Auto play' and changed the description of the setting value from 'On' and 'Off' to 'Only one option' and 'Off' (no change in functionality).
[*] Changed the description of the 'Auto Transition' option to 'Scoring Summary' and changed the setting values from 'On' and 'Off' to 'Auto' and 'Pause' (no change in functionality).
[*]Added a feature to display the score difference with other players when clicking on the central scoreboard.
[*]Removed some beta indicators, etc. in line with the official implementation.
[*]Partial changes have been made to the display of credits.
[/list]

[h3]Bugfix[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where some text in the 'The Tille Zoo' content in the 'Tutorial' was displayed in Japanese when the display language was set to English.
[/list]


With this update, we can say that the game was originally playable enough in beta, but now that the multiplayer mode has been 'officially' released, we think we have all the features we need to have fun with our friends.

However, we will continue to update the game in the future.
We have a number of things planned, such as language support and some display improvements, and we will let you know when we are ready to talk about them in more detail.

We look forward to your continued support of Japanese Style Tien Gow.

notes.title: Notice about the next update version 2.0
notes.content:
Hello to all of you who have been enjoying Tien Gow.
I had planned to make this announcement a little earlier, but as I have been working on various things, the Steam Autumn Sale is just around the corner....

I realize how quickly time flies.

We are currently offering multiplayer as a beta feature in "Japanese Style Tien Gow".
This will finally be released as an official feature!


As for that specific scheduled date... it will be Wednesday evening, November 27, 2024 (Japan time)!


Although we cannot confirm a specific time, due to the developer's circumstances, we would like to reflect the update "while it is still the 27th".
And the timing of the update means that...[b]"Japanese Style Tien Gow" will also participate in the Steam Autumn Sale![/b]

If you haven't bought the game yet, we recommend that you wait until the sale is over to make sure you get the discounted price!

...Of course, you are also welcome to purchase the game at the regular price.

Now, there are a few things in the next update, including the addition of some titles and the implementation of a "Title Gacha"... but in this preview, I want to focus on a few smaller changes.

All of which will make the game more enjoyable.

The first is the ability to control your tiles while others are playing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44317676/fbad9556ab1f69cc27462ad8a0949cc2aa52e4ad.gif[/img]
This will allow the game to run more smoothly if you have already decided which tile to select in advance. Previously, you could not select a tile until it was your turn, so there was a bit of a "wait and see" feeling, but this will be eliminated.

The second is "the ability to cancel tile selection by right-clicking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44317676/5864461142cf5467017a7f1972de349cac73dd13.gif[/img]
Previously, if you wanted to select a different tile, you had to click on the selected tile again to change it.
This will also be convenient, as it can be canceled with a single right-click.

The third is "the ability to display a final confirmation that the selected tile is to be played face-down when the face-down button is pressed while selecting a tile that would win if played face-up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44317676/4b7f42bf1640351ab9aca62509fb0473384fbd93.gif[/img]
We had a number of cases where players who were used to playing the game would try to play the game quickly and often accidentally flip a tile that was supposed to be up.
This was an issue with the UI layout and interface design, but in order not to confuse existing players, we decided not to make any major changes to the layout and instead show a confirmation instead of just running the game as is.
We hope that this will prevent many players from making a mistake and losing at a critical moment.

And the fourth is "a feature that displays the score difference from other players when you click on the scoreboard.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44317676/0bed7b32ce8fd6c9efddb03aed8bec903e57393d.gif[/img]
When you check the difference with other players, you no longer have to calculate it in your head.
However, if you are an experienced player, you may be able to figure it out just by looking... but we hope you will use this feature as one of the convenient functions.


These are the features that are added or changed to make the experience more comfortable, even if they are not very important.
I would be happy if you could confirm the addition of various features related to "titles" by touching them directly on the day of the event.

So please stay tuned for next week's update.

notes.title: Released "Japanese Style Tien Gow" for MacOS.
notes.content:
"Japanese Style Tien Gow" is now available for Mac.
The Mac OS version has been requested since we first announced the release of the game, and we are pleased to finally be able to respond to this request.

All functions are the same as the Windows version.
This means that those who have been saying “I want to play but I don't have a Windows PC...” will now be able to play the game.

And of course, the multiplayer function, which is still in beta testing, will also allow you to play against players of the Windows version.
(However, if you have trouble playing multiplayer, please report it on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2299520/discussions/]"Japanese Style Tien Gow" discassions[/url].)
You can also invite your friends to play against each other. 4-player game, but you can mix in NPCs if you need more.

To celebrate this release, we will be having a 7-day sale starting 8/29/11 at 11pm.
(Please note that all dates and times are based on Japan Standard Time.)
We will offer the same -15% as we did when the Windows version was released!

If you have been curious about the game, just found out about it through this news, or forgot about it, please take this opportunity to purchase it if you haven't already! If you have not yet purchased the game, this is a great opportunity to do so.

After this, we will continue working on the official implementation of multiplayer.
We look forward to your continued support for "Japanese Style Tien Gow" in the future!

notes.title: Update of the trial version and planned release of the MacOS version
notes.content:
Hello to all who enjoy playing Tien-Gow.

We would like to inform you about the update of the demo version and the release date of the MacOS version.

First, about the demo version.
We are currently working on some improvements to the full version of the game to make it more enjoyable to play.
However, the demo version has not been updated to reflect these improvements.
We have updated the demo version to reflect these improvements, so you can now try it out as close to the current production version as possible.

Second, we have suddenly made a trial version of the MacOS version available.
By the time you see this notice, you will be able to try the trial version on MacOS.

And of course, now that the trial version is available, we plan to offer the full product version.
The MacOS version will be released on the evening of [b]August 29, 2024[/b] (Japan time).

The MacOS version is basically the same as the Windows version,
The multiplayer feature currently in beta testing will also be available.
The MacOS version is basically the same as the Windows version, and the multiplayer feature currently in beta testing will be available.

We apologize for the sudden announcement, but we hope that those who have been waiting for the MacOS version will try the demo and look forward to the release date.

notes.title: Information about the 1.3.1 update
notes.content:
Hello to all who enjoy playing Tien gow.

Version 1.3.1, Net Version.1.0.5

[/list]

This is the content of this update.
We hope you enjoy it.

notes.title: 1.3.0 Update (Multiplayer Beta Update) Information
notes.content:
Hello to all who enjoy Tien gow. And here we go.
We are pleased to announce that we have made some additions and changes to the multiplayer beta features of "Japanese Style Tien Gow" and other features.

[h1]Update 1.3.0 Patch Notes[/h1]

[b][h2]Specification Additions/Changes[/h2][/b]

[h3]Addition of Multi play (Beta) feature and related changes[/h3]
The "Start Game" on the title screen now displays "Single Play" and "(Beta) Multi play".
When "(Beta) Multi play" is selected, a message will be displayed only once (there will be two pages of messages during the beta period).
After that, the necessary items for Multi play will be displayed.
You can recruit a large number of players by selecting "Create Room", and you can find and join such a room by selecting "Join Room".

[h3]●Multi play Features in Detail[/h3]
[list]
[*]You can set up to four players and one spectator. (You can also be the spectator and invite four players.)
[*]If four real players are not available, you can randomly add NPCs that you have unlocked in single-player mode.
*Note: You cannot place the same NPC more than once.
[*]You can recruit players either publicly or privately (by invitation or passcode verification).
[*]You can set the same rules as in single-player mode.
[*]You can set a time limit, and tiles will be played randomly when the time runs out.
[*]Personal stats, match records, and levels for multiplayer mode are recorded independently of single-player mode.
[/list]

If you find any problems, please report them to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2299520/discussions/]discussions[/url].
If you experience any problems, we recommend that you quit and restart the game.


[h3]Four new BGM tracks added for matches[/h3]
Four additional BGM tracks will be added to multiplayer matches.
Including the four existing tracks, eight tracks will be randomly played during the matches.


[h3]Custom Player Title Added[/h3]
A feature has been added that allows you to customize your title for display to other players.
While there are very few player titles available in the beta, a feature to increase titles (Title Gacha) will be implemented in the official release.
*This is not an addition to in-game purchases.


[h3]Rich Presence Display Added[/h3]
Support for Steam's Rich Presence system has been added to reflect the state of the game.
It will now show friends detailed information about the current state of the game (e.g. if you are recruiting multiplayer players, if you are playing, etc.).


[h3]Multiplayer Notice Added[/h3]
Multiplayer is a fun way to play with others, but it is also a feature that can cause problems.
Although there is no communication feature implemented in the game itself, we hope you will keep in mind the importance of having fun and check the notices whenever necessary.
Please note that during the beta period, there will also be notifications that this is a beta test, so please check them accordingly.


[h3]Levels and experience will be added to personal stats.[/h3]
The player's current level is now added to the Personal stats section, so the player can check their current level at any time.


[h3]Known bugs confirmed at this time
The following are known bugs that have been confirmed by the developer.[/h3]

[list]
[*]When a spectator is disconnected and a player is disconnected, communication may not be restored.
[*]When a spectator changes a player’s viewpoint, the disconnected player may not be reflected correctly.
[*] The avatar icon of the player who disconnected during the previous match may remain in the lobby.
[/list]

Those are the details of this update.
Although still in beta, this update allows players to play over the network!
You can join from the room list, so it is possible to play with people who are not your friends, but at this time we recommend playing with friends.
From here, we will continue to work out communication issues and implement features for the official launch.
Please let us know if you encounter any problems, or if you have any comments or suggestions about the feature by posting on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2299520/discussions/]discussions[/url].

Also, here is some information for streamers interested in our multiplayer feature.
Castle Box Games has established a set of guidelines that we ask you to read before posting your live stream or video. (We don't think the rules are that different from the rest of the site).

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/castleboxgames/discussions/0/6699728899099288746/]Castle Box Games Digital Game Usage Guidelines[/url]
The guidelines are in Japanese only.

We've finally made it this far.
We went from "a game where you can discover a game that is almost unknown in Japan" to "a game where you can play with friends in a game that is almost unknown in Japan".
We will continue to work hard until the game is officially released, but for now, we hope you enjoy the multiplayer feature!

notes.title: About the Multiplayer Beta Update
notes.content:
*News announcements in English are machine translated.

Hello to all of you who have been playing or are currently interested in playing "Japanese Style Tien Gow".
We are currently working on the implementation of a multiplayer update to "Japanese Style Tien Gow" and we would like to give you an update on what we are planning to do with it.

As previously announced, multiplayer will be a beta feature, and we are pleased to announce that a specific date has been set for its implementation.

[b]The beta launch date is scheduled for Thursday, June 27th (Japan time)[/b].

[u]The Steam Summer Sale is coming up the next day[/u], right? Is this a coincidence...?

Now, in the beta version, we will provide the game with mainly implemented features for playing against each other.
Let me show you just one image here that you can see is a multiplayer screen.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44317676/2fb8f13c0e98ed54cd0145bbc24bb619b9ab3243.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44317676/3f6a8ab592ab30624b2505530be3c7be6589178c.png[/img][/url]

This update does not require any procedures or configuration changes on your part.
After the update is distributed, simply update the game and launch it to access the Multiplayer Beta feature.

The beta version of the game will have a new multiplayer experience value, which will be reset once the official version of the game is implemented. (Records and achievements will not be reset.)

Other announced features include translation into other languages, but please wait a little longer.
We will concentrate on providing stable multiplayer functionality first.

We are very close to the beta update! Please look forward to it.

notes.title: About the 1.2 Update Information
notes.content:
*News announcements in English are machine translated.

Thank you for enjoying "Japanese Style Tien Gow".
We are pleased to announce the second improvement update of "Japanese Style Tien Gow" with some additional specifications, changes.

[h1]Update 1.2 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2][b]Specification additions and changes[/b][/h2]

[h3]Changes to tile expressions[/h3]
The display of tile eyes was a little oval-shaped, so we have changed the display to make the eyes of the tiles more circular while still showing the texture of the tiles.
The left side below is after the change and the right side is before the change.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44317676/4649f08fb926401ddf24a62a5168f02534c97612.png[/img].

[h3]Improvement of the guide display when launching[/h3]
We have improved the display to show the strength of the selected tile when the guide is opened with a selection that allows the player to reveal a tile during the launch.
If you are not yet familiar with the game, you can open the guide with any of the tiles selected.
If a combination of tiles cannot be displayed in the table, the table of contents will be displayed.

[h3]Add summary view[/h3]
In response to requests for a comprehensive view of all tiles, 
we have added a summary view button that allows you to check the tiles and order used in hitting "Tien gow" during the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44317676/37d2a8763743588b70eaeca321a17399ec036a56.png[/img]
This summary shows that up to 4 tiles can be simultaneously played if the combination of tiles surrounded by a light blue frame, and that
The guide explains that the two tiles surrounded by a red border can be played at the same time in a hand to achieve supreme honor.
Please use this guide together with the previous ones as needed.


[h3]Addition of a function to display game records[/h3]
A record function has been added to show the movement of scores, which can also be called a match log.
This allows you to look back on parental transitions, changes in scores, and the conclusion of special roles.
This feature will be added in a future multiplayer update when it becomes possible to play against other players,
This feature has been prepared in preparation for a more enjoyable experience when the game becomes available in a future multiplayer update.

These are the details of this update.

We have also added several features and improvements to this update.
These updates have been made in preparation for the multiplayer update that you have been waiting for, and we hope you will enjoy it as much as we have.

We plan to add more multiplayer features in the future, of course, but multiplayer is a feature that often has some glitches in any game. For a team like ours that is developing in between our day jobs, it is very difficult to release a multiplayer feature all at once without any glitches.
For this reason, we envision that the multiplayer feature will be developed slowly, with additional features added as a beta first, before an official release. We appreciate your patience, and we hope you will give us a little more time.

In addition, we are considering adding Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese languages on a machine translation basis in the next update.
If you have any suggestions after the release of this update, please let us know on the bulletin board.

Please look forward to the next update.

notes.title: About the 1.1 Update Information
notes.content:
*News announcements in English are machine translated.

Thank you for enjoying "Japanese Style Tien Gow".
We are pleased to announce the first improvement update of "Japanese Style Tien Gow" with some additional specifications, changes, and bug fixes.

[h1]Update 1.1 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2][b]Game Changes[/b][/h2]

[h3]Saving game mode settings[/h3]
The "Game Mode" "Max Dealer Multiplier" "Init Score" and "Less than 0 point" settings on the screen before the game starts will now be retained, whereas previously they returned to their default values each time.

[h3]Change tile position[/h3]
When you progress through the game, the tiles used to be aligned to the left, but now they are aligned to the right. This allows you to always play in close proximity to the face up and face down buttons.
　
[h3]Added a direction to display the number of games[/h3]
Added a direction to display the current game count in the center of the screen at the beginning of the game. If it is the last game, it displays "Final Game".
　
[h3]Display of turn[/h3]
The yellow light on the score board in the center now blinks when it is the player's turn to move.

[h3]Added a new direction for displaying the game results after the game[/h3]
When displaying the results at the end of a match, experience gain factors are now displayed one line at a time instead of being listed all at once.
　
[h3]Added expression to rearrange tiles[/h3]
Added animation for rearranging tiles after they have been dealt.
The rearrangement is done in the order of the Wen tiles, followed by the Wu tiles. Also, the tiles are now sorted from left to right in order of strength, making it easier to understand the strength of the tiles.
　
[h3]Tutorial Improvements[/h3]
We have strengthened the explanation of the face-down rule and emphasized "any of the tiles in the hand may be played face-down". We hope this will help convey the rules without misunderstanding.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where one achievement could not be unlocked when the display language was set to English, because the game did not properly recognize the "5. Gee Joon" when it was viewed.
This allows the game to correctly recognize the achievement by viewing it again after the 1.1 update, and the achievement can be unlocked if the conditions are met.
[/list]


These are the contents of this update.

We plan to make another improvement update in the next issue, and we are also slowly working on the implementation of the multiplayer update.
We hope that you will continue to wait with anticipation.

notes.title: About future updates
notes.content:
Hello to all of you who enjoy Tien Gow.

Thank you for enjoying "Japanese Style Tien Gow".
As we have previously announced, "Japanese Style Tien Gow" will not end its development after its release, but will be updated.

We have been checking the reactions, mainly from those who learned of the news and played the game between the release of the trial version and now, regarding what kind of updates we would like to make to the game.

As a result, we have decided to schedule three updates that will make some improvements or add functions.

*The image below is in Japanese text only.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44317676/8d5f36ce5861b3e751b5c2498a6cc52e10d0cfad.png[/img]

First, two improvement updates are currently planned.
Improvement updates are scheduled to improve various displays to make them easier to understand, and to improve parts of the system that are difficult to operate.
Please be assured that these two updates are separate from the "hot fixes" that will fix urgent problems.

We are also planning to implement the "Multiplayer" feature that many of you have been asking for, but we have decided to do it after the improvement update!
In between improvement updates, we will continue to develop the multiplayer feature, so that we can release it without any problems.
We are also considering releasing a "Multiplayer Beta" version to those who have the full version of the game when we have made some progress in development.
We will let you know when the time is closer, so please wait until then.

Please feel free to send us your feedback on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2299520/discussions/]forum[/url] so that we can consider incorporating it into our update plan at this time.

We are very happy and encouraged by the positive reviews and feedback we have received since our release.
We will continue to develop the software to meet your expectations, and we thank you in advance for your continued support.

*This announcement was made by machine translation.

notes.title: "Japanese Style Tien Gow" is out now on Steam!
notes.content:
Today (November 22, 2023 on JST), we launched the distribution of "Japanese Style Tien Gow", a PC version of the traditional Chinese game of "Tien Gow"!

Although the game is titled "Japanese Style," the rules are basically the same as those used in Hong Kong and Macau, where the game is played.
Some of the rules and names of the roles have been changed for this game, and some elements for which we did not have sufficient information at the time of production have been given their own names.
Therefore, please be aware that there are slight differences in the names of some elements from those currently available on the Internet.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2299520/_/

We will continue to keep the demo version, so if you are interested, please play with the demo version.
Only the basic rules are explained in the tutorial of the demo version.
(In the full version, you will be able to understand the entire rules in the tutorial.)

In addition, we have established guidelines in response to the recent popularity of live game streaming.
If you are going to stream a live game, please read the guidelines before you start streaming (the guidelines are explained in Japanese).

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/castleboxgames/discussions/0/6699728899099288746/]Castle Box Games デジタルゲーム利用ガイドライン[/url]

Finally...with the help of many people, we are finally able to offer this game to you.
However, this game is not finished with its release, and we are planning to update it several times.
We will announce those at a later date, so please look forward to them.

*This announcement was made by machine translation.
